note: The toolbar badge is browser UI: CDP cannot screenshot it and this machine has no screen-capture tool (GNOME screenshot D-Bus is denied, no import/xwd/ffmpeg). Badge state is asserted through chrome.action.getBadgeText/getBadgeBackgroundColor/getBadgeTextColor and left as a manual check (a green "TTS" chip on the toolbar icon). Real Ctrl+Shift+Y key presses cannot be dispatched through CDP either — the handler (__humanplayTtsTest.invokeToggle, the exact function chrome.commands.onCommand calls) is invoked instead; pressing the physical shortcut is a manual check.
